verificationEnvironment: Windows; Node v24.22.1; ExifReader 4.52.0; @contentauth/c2pa-web 0.15.4; Chromium 1248 via Playwright 1.64.1
notes: Synthetic fixtures are generated deterministically by test code, not downloaded content.
Committed PNG fixtures are reproduced by their generator script and written with stored deflate blocks, so the bytes do not depend on a local zlib build.
plain-3x2.png and plain-3x2-filtered.png carry the same pixel grid in two PNG encodings, so the V18 case can show a byte difference beside an unchanged preview measurement.
C2PA expectations come from recorded output of the pinned SDK in a real Chromium run. No file is described as valid or trusted because of its name, its source page, or a website description.
A filename is never evidence for an expected result.
The reference manifest store is a reduced hand-normalized extract used to cross-check claim fields only. It carries no validation status and proves nothing about validity or trust.
